statement.p: A ball that is dropped from a window hits the ground in 8 seconds. How high is the window? (Give your answer in feet; note that the acceleration due to gravity is 32 ft/s{}^2.)

static.solution: a(t)=-32. Since v(t) is the antiderivative of a(t), v(t)=-32t + v_0. But v_0=0, so v(t)=-32 t. Since s(t) is the antiderivative of v(t), s(t)=-16 t^2 + s_0, where s_0 is the height of the building. Since the ball hits the ground in 8 seconds, s(8)=0=-16(8)^2+s_0. Hence s_0=1024 feet, so the window is 1024 feet high.
